agent-mcp-deployment-secrets.description: The live agent-mcp deployment secrets/provider keys currently supplied as ADHD_AGENT_* env vars (e.g. ADHD_AGENT_OPENAI_SECRET, ADHD_AGENT_ANTHROPIC_SECRET, ADHD_AGENT_DEEPSEEK_SECRET, ADHD_AGENT_DATABASE_PATH). The refactor MUST preserve these exact names via envPrefixOverride: ADHD_AGENT + per-field env overrides so no deployed secret silently stops resolving after cutover.
agent-mcp-deployment-secrets.how_to_provide: Confirm the deployed agent-mcp env var contract (ADHD_AGENT_* names — no _MCP_ segment, no namespace suffix) matches CURRENT_CONFIG_PATTERNS.md §agent-mcp 'Env vars used', and that adhd.environment.yaml sets envPrefixOverride: ADHD_AGENT with per-field env overrides reproducing every legacy name. Ensure the secrets are present in the deployment environment before agent-mcp cutover.
agent-mcp-deployment-secrets.resolution_note: ENV-PLAN-007: verified against the landed zero-config design (entrypoint/agent-mcp/src/config.ts:89-93, :224-259) that ADHD_AGENT_DATABASE_PATH and ADHD_AGENT_OPENAI_SECRET are optional EnvironmentSpec fields with zero-config fallbacks (db.path falls back to env.files.db; provider secrets are resolved lazily via env.resolveEnvName only when getProviderConfig is invoked for that specific provider). Neither is read at Environment construction time, so agent-mcp build/test do not require them. Verified: `env -u ADHD_AGENT_OPENAI_SECRET -u ADHD_AGENT_DATABASE_PATH npx nx affected -t test --files=entrypoint/agent-mcp/src/config.ts` exits 0.

cargo-registry-token.description: crates.io API token for the FUTURE publish pipeline of the environment-core-rs crate. IMPORTANT — as of this plan the publish pipeline is UNIMPLEMENTED: a repo-wide search for `cargo publish`, `CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN`, `uv publish`, and `twine` across every project.json/package.json returns nothing, and environment-core-rs has no project.json at all (it is not yet an nx-registered project, so no nx-release-publish target exists). The round-1 claim that this token is 'consumed by the environment-core-rs nx-release-publish target defined in scaffold-workspace project.json' was FALSE and is retracted (F14). This credential is therefore PUBLISH-ONLY and entirely UNENFORCED by any current build/test/audit: runtime-rs's guard is `rustup run 1.95.0 cargo build`, which never touches crates.io. `required_by: [runtime-rs]` names the crate's owning state for provenance/traceability only — it is NOT an execution dependency (gap-check requires required_by to be non-empty and name a real node, so the owning state is used as that anchor). `blocks_at: release` defers all enforcement until a release/publish target is implemented and run; until then this blocker halts no wave.
cargo-registry-token.how_to_provide: FIRST implement the release path (register environment-core-rs as an nx project and add an nx-release-publish / `cargo publish --token $CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN` target) — this does not exist yet. THEN: crates.io -> Account Settings -> API Tokens -> New Token (publish scope for the adhd-environment crate); export CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN in the release environment before invoking publish.
cargo-registry-token.verification: test -n "$CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN"  # presence-only; there is no publish target to exercise yet, so this cannot verify a live release. Meaningful only once the (currently unimplemented) publish pipeline exists.
cargo-registry-token.note: Publish-only credential for an UNIMPLEMENTED pipeline. No `cargo publish`/`nx-release-publish` target exists in the repo today; wiring one is future work. Enforced only at a future `nx release publish`, never at any build/test/audit wave.
